FRESH INDEPENDENT NON-AUTHOR SOURCE REVIEW, SEAT A. Actual identity: claude-opus-4-8 (Opus 4.8), high effort, reported honestly. Requested model was claude-opus-4-8; both 4.8 and 5.5 are user-authorized per USER-BOTH-OPUS-RULE.md. I am a fresh non-author context, but my model (claude-opus-4-8) is the SAME model that authored test Parts A (R01-R08), B (R09-R13) and C (R14-R17); the prefix+R00 were authored by claude-opus-5-5. This is same-provider, same-model-as-authors-of-A/B/C; it is NOT provider diversity and NOT model-author-independence for those parts. Two substantive agreeing fresh votes remain required for any consequential decision. nativeAuthority 0; nothing was executed, imported, compiled, AST-parsed, hashed or dispatched. This is source-only, one attempt, no retry.

SCOPE AND ROUTE. I read the direct packet public bodies (not the 25 READ-SEGMENT JSONL route) to avoid redundancy. I fully read: MANIFEST.json, SEGMENT-INDEX.json, the entire 1119-line test_c2_builder_r4.py, the three dependency sources (build_k10_inputs.py 554 lines, c2_issue_artifacts_r2.py 508, host_codec.py 656), K6/K2/HIST-09 fixtures, R4-CONTRACT.md (CB401-412 + R00-R17), R4-API.json, C2-PROFILE-R2-API.json, the three part contracts and three part notes, prefix notes, ROOT-CP08-SOURCE-ADOPTION.json, ROOT-MEANINGFULNESS-ACCEPTANCE.json, ROOT-PUBLIC-FIXTURE-PINS.json, ROOT-LITERAL-ASSEMBLY.json, PROPOSED-RED-ENVELOPE.json, R4-TEST-INTERFACE.json, DOWNSTREAM-R4-CONDITIONAL-ADOPTION.json, SOL-RENDERER.py.txt, USER-BOTH-OPUS-RULE.md. B9-APPLIED-BLUEPRINT.json is a genuine public-opaque fixture; per instruction I verified only its root pin (308672 bytes, SHA 10baa179...) and the legacy extractor code, synthesizing no fixture. The B9 body, C2-PROFILE-R2-CONTRACT.md full body and SOL-INTEGRATION-CONTRACT.md were not read (justified below).

LITERAL ASSEMBLY (FX01). ROOT-LITERAL-ASSEMBLY.json records raw byte concatenation prefix(27341)+A(15652)+B(9290)+C(8083). 27341+15652+9290+8083 = 60366, equal to the pinned test file (60366 bytes, 1119 lines, SHA c9375097...), which the packet MANIFEST corroborates. The assembled module defines four TestCase subclasses plus R4TestBase; R4TestBase carries only helpers (r4, plan, refused, run_argv, run_main, assert_cli_refusal, assert_cli_success, wrapped, counted, faulted, consumer_wrapper, case_scratch, copy_inputs, assert_inputs_unchanged) and NO test_* method, so it contributes zero tests; exactly 18 test methods are discoverable (R00x1 at 496, R01-R08 at 567/601/617/658/692/710/755/797, R09-R13 at 847/862/892/933/958, R14-R17 at 993/1021/1046/1081); a single footer unittest.main(verbosity=2) at 1118-1119. Each R01-R17 method's first statement is self.r4() (test_r12 binds r4=self.r4()); I confirmed no assertion or effect precedes it on every method.

R00 INDEPENDENCE AND SOUNDNESS (FX02). test_r00_prerequisites (496-551) never calls self.r4(); it depends only on prefix literals, RAW pinned bytes, the pinned legacy/host_codec/r2 modules, and derived formatters. I independently verified the structural oracles: (a) legacy.frozen_positive_cbor(f1,f5) (build_k10_inputs.py 308-319) is byte-identical to prefix env_cbor(*f) (297-302) given FAMILY==FAMILY_V2, EXPORT.predicateDigest==PREDICATE_DIGEST (K6 line 10 == legacy line 91, 0d2302...019bd), claimant 0x55x28==CLAIMANT_VKH, txid 0x22x32==SETTLE_TXID, ix 0, expiry 1893456000000==TEST_EXPIRY; (b) prefix ctx_text (305-317) reproduces legacy.script_context+uplc_term node-for-node (16 tx_info fields, claim_output, everything_interval, redeemer, script_info) and the actual pinned HIST-09 bytes match that render field-for-field (policy 6a4b67e7..., token 9fd5c53f..., all 9 env nodes, VK a1d3..., proof a2d1...); (c) host_codec.encode_data(build_env_data(...)) reproduces prefix env_cbor (tag 0xd879, indefinite 0x9f...0xff, 0x5820/0x581c heads, 0x1b expiry) and build_value_data(None,[(policy,token,1)]) yields a1581c+POLICY+a15820+K6_TOKEN+01 == MINT_VALUE_CBOR_HEX; (d) r2.prepare_c2_issue returns the 12 RESULT_KEYS, format moriarty-c2-issue-artifacts/2, and _LABELS in the exact C2-PROFILE-R2-API S34 order/values that prefix R2_LABELS mirrors. R00's count assertions (12/16/11/7/8/14 and 33/9/4/10) match the literals I counted. The six GOVERNANCE_PINS (R4-CONTRACT.md, R4-API.json, CP r2 contract/API, DOWNSTREAM-R4-CONDITIONAL-ADOPTION.json, ROOT-CP08-SOURCE-ADOPTION.json) are defined in the prefix but are NOT referenced by any test method; they are out-of-envelope root pre/post assembly checks (PROPOSED-RED-ENVELOPE governancePinsRuntimeLayoutNote; the RED layout ships only 8 files, so R00 cannot and does not read them). I re-verified all six pins against the packet MANIFEST; they match exactly. ADOPTED_R2_PIN (21648, 67fb3b3e...) equals the ROOT-CP08 adopted candidate. My decision: root mechanical governance-pin verification + R00's runtime pin/behavior checks + this source audit satisfy the current R00 obligation, including the literalCompatibility recheck ROOT-CP08 requires; recorded, not silently waived.

ORDINARY RED (FX03) AND EFFECTS (FX05). I independently predict the envelope result (see predictedRedResult). The host launch command (timeout 20s TERM/kill-after-2s; prlimit cpu 10:10, as 536870912, fsize 2097152, core 0; bwrap --unshare-all --die-with-parent --new-session, ro-bind /usr, isolated bound read-only, scratch bound writable, --chdir isolated, --clearenv, PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, LANG=C.UTF-8, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; python3.14 -I -B) is read-only isolated, unprivileged-intended, with stdout/stderr to separate exclusive REGULAR files bounded by inherited RLIMIT_FSIZE (explicitly NOT pipes). I note, per the envelope and its own disclosure, that rlimits are not a network sandbox and that bwrap --unshare-all is only a proposal whose actual effect is unobserved at source time; PROPOSED-RED-ENVELOPE is NOT execution permission. The suite's own effects: read_bounded is no-follow O_NONBLOCK bounded; writes go only under per-test scratch/<method>; instrumentation (wrapped/counted/faulted/consumer_wrapper) is restricted by wrapped() to r2/host_codec/legacy and restored in finally; os/builtins/json/R4 are never patched; redirect_stdout/stderr swap only sys streams. At RED, R00 reads only; every R01-R17 fails at self.r4() before any scratch write, so scratch stays empty 0700 and all 8 files stay byte-unchanged.

MEANINGFULNESS (FX04). See stubMeaningfulnessPrediction. R01 is the structural gate a conforming stub passes by construction; the acceptance predicate (contract section 8, ROOT-MEANINGFULNESS-ACCEPTANCE, envelope meaningfulness) correctly scopes to R02-R17, all of which invoke builder behavior that a NotImplementedError stub cannot satisfy.

INDEPENDENT EXPECTATIONS AND FUTURE GREEN (FX06). Every expected value traces to prefix literals/formatters, the frozen contract/API, or the pinned r2/host_codec/legacy modules (independent of R4), never to build_k10_inputs_r4.py output; I confirmed this per method. Negative fixtures are explicitly-invalid, not synthetic proofs: R03 reuses the genuine K6 proof against an edited statement (labelled), R11 injects 22 in-place mutations of the genuine r2 result (13 R3 test_08 vectors + 9 R4-specific; I counted 22 edit tuples at 902-924), R12 applies 7 shape/type mutations to the admitted env tree. R17 counts host-call presence by run-minus-baseline difference (consumer reaches 7, builder adds exactly its 4), not exact totals. The counts 33 manifest keys / 16 consumerLabels / 9 builderLabels / 10 false flags / 4 limitations / 12 result keys / 11 stages / 7 consumer APIs / 4 builder APIs are all accurate. Artifact-only scope is preserved: all 20 UTxO families, full finance, ACTUS, DeFi, PCD recursion, private handoff, multiparent and real Preprod remain OPEN; no curve/Groth16/Rust-acceptance/ledger inference is drawn (CB412; no subset relation; R13 scans every manifest string for 'subset' and the actual literals are subset-free). Recorded gap (F01): R13 asserts set(manifest)==MANIFEST_KEYS (presence) but asserts VALUES for only a subset; beyond the four API-unrestated keys (compiledValidatorTitle, scriptHexFile, scriptCompiledBytes, scriptInnerFlatBytes, disclosed in Parts B/C notes), several keptFromR2 fields that DO have prefix literals (auditSourcePins, the scriptHash* strings, vkDigestHex, statementDigestHex, vkBytes, proofBytes, scriptHashClaimedHex, scriptHashIndependentlyRecomputedHex) also go value-unasserted. This under-captures the future GREEN oracle but is non-blocking for RED and meaningfulness; recorded for the downstream combined-source/GREEN audit, not waived.

ADOPTION / NON-CLAIMS / ROUTING (FX07). ROOT-CP08-SOURCE-ADOPTION.json adopts the exact r2 bytes for ordinary artifact preparation and R4 TEST AUTHORING ONLY (implementationAdopted true for the r2 component; R4TestAuthoringPermitted true; R4ExecutionPermitted false; R4ImplementationPermittedByThisRecord false; builderReliancePermitted false; nativeAuthority 0). This is a scoped historical requirement, read as such, not blanket permission; it permits authoring one ordinary R4 RED, never builder reliance/native/VM/prover/ledger. v1 c2_issue_artifacts.py stays prohibited and is absent (setUpModule STOPs if present or imported; R00 asserts find_spec None); CB r1 is not routed; r2 is not relabeled as an old source profile. The Muse Sol-glue seat is replaced by Gemini 4 Argon High (non-security); security stays actual Opus. The two prior DOWNSTREAM Opus-4.8 contract reviews (CB401-412 AGREE) are context, not votes on this test source; their R4-F03 (r2 absent → RED blocked) is now resolved because the adopted r2 bytes are present and pinned, and their R4-F05 (pin the 33 keys) is the task R13 now discharges for presence.

CONCLUSION. The combined prefix+A+B+C source is internally consistent, conforms to CB401-412 and the section-7 R00-R17 obligations and all three part contracts, derives no expectation from the code under test, and is predicted to produce exactly the proposed ordinary RED (1 pass, 17 MISSING failures, 0 errors) and to be meaningful against a CB401 stub. sourceReady and ordinaryRedReady are justified, bounded strictly to root consideration of one ordinary RED. implementationReady and builderReliancePermitted are false. The one host execution remains root-gated and must be followed by a fresh actual-result audit; I did not and cannot execute. Findings F01-F04 are non-blocking and recorded.
